title: Weak limit on G(N,n) from convergence on a dense set (printed (3)–(4) and the Riesz step of Lemma 8.1.3)
statement: Let G = G(N,n), a compact Hausdorff second-countable space with its Borel σ-algebra. Let l be a nontrivial filter on ℝ, and (m_ρ)_{ρ∈ℝ} Borel measures on G such that m_ρ is a probability measure for l-eventually all ρ. Let D ⊆ C(G,ℝ) be dense for the sup-norm topology (the topology of C(G,ℝ), as G is compact), and suppose lim_l ∫ f dm_ρ exists in ℝ for every f ∈ D. Then there is a Borel probability measure η on G with ∫ f dm_ρ → ∫ f dη along l for every f ∈ C(G,ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (l : Filter ℝ) (m : ℝ → Measure (Grassmannian N n)) (D : Set C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), l.NeBot → (∀ᶠ ρ in l, IsProbabilityMeasure (m ρ)) → Dense D → (∀ f ∈ D, ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun ρ ↦ ∫ S, f S ∂(m ρ)) l (𝓝 c)) → ∃ η : Measure (Grassmannian N n), IsProbabilityMeasure η ∧ ∀ f : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ ↦ ∫ S, f S ∂(m ρ)) l (𝓝 (∫ S, f S ∂η))
